name: bdrivex-vendor-bmail
description: Builds js/vendor/message-box-client.js (the MessageBox client bDriveX uses to send a bMail notice) and holds the local test relay's deps. See README.md.

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --minify --legal-comments=none --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --banner:js='/*! @bsv/message-box-client 2.5.4 + @bsv/sdk 2.8.11 + @bsv/authsocket-client 2.1.7 (Open BSV License), bundled for bDriveX. Rebuild: scripts/vendor-bmail/README.md */' --outfile=../../js/vendor/message-box-client.js
